appDescription: Dongbancha is a travel diary that records conversations during a trip with the occupants' consent.

function.name: PAUSE_TRIP_RECORDING
function.description: Turn off or pause Dongbancha's in-car conversation recording for the current trip.

function.name: RESUME_TRIP_RECORDING
function.description: Restart paused in-car conversation recording for the current trip in Dongbancha.
